# Third-party notices for QDM

Application: QDM 0.2.0. Selected target: `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`.

This bundle contains the published notices for **119 active Cargo dependencies** in the selected Windows normal/build dependency tree. It also retains notices for **13 additional packages** present in Cargo's resolved metadata; those packages are listed separately and are not claimed to be linked into QDM.

Version, declared license expression, repository, and feature information were read from the locked Cargo metadata. Original notice text has been copied without modification. Build tools and procedural macros are included when they are part of the normal/build tree; their inclusion in this list does not mean their executable code is shipped inside QDM.

The Rust standard library is not a Cargo package. Its official release notice is included separately below. No proprietary Internet Download Manager code, assets, or license text is included in this bundle.

Cargo.lock SHA-256: `caf3b17925692e99b365da5475ff389a2aa9c57deefe71c0c13466fbe2fad51d`.

Machine-readable package provenance and notice-file SHA-256 values: [licenses.json](licenses.json).

## Rust standard library

Rust 1.99.1, commit `58cf8f9c35b355199727627d07ae34a4e2846d67`. The supplied notice covers the standard-library source and its component exceptions across supported platforms; not every item in that upstream notice is present in the Windows executable.

- [Complete standard-library copyright and component notices](rust-standard-library/COPYRIGHT-library.html)
- [MIT license](rust-standard-library/LICENSE-MIT.txt)
- [Apache 2.0 license](rust-standard-library/LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt)
- [Exact standard-library source revision](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/tree/58cf8f9c35b355199727627d07ae34a4e2846d67/library)

## Notice provenance exception

`alloc-stdlib` 0.3.0 declares BSD-3-Clause but its published archive omits a separate license file. Its repository-root LICENSE was retrieved from the exact release commit recorded by its packaged `.cargo_vcs_info.json`:

[Dropbox rust-alloc-no-stdlib, commit 0a81fd6928ea3b33c8cd484aa4575d50ffb98012](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dropbox/rust-alloc-no-stdlib/0a81fd6928ea3b33c8cd484aa4575d50ffb98012/LICENSE).

## Reproduction inputs

```text
cargo metadata --offline --locked --filter-platform x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --format-version 1
cargo tree --offline --locked --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --edges normal,build --prefix none --format '{p}'
```

Preserve these notices with binary and source distributions. Individual license texts and their retained copyright notices govern their respective components.
